recipes.description: resolveEntities() crashes on undefined specs in schema codegen — missing null guard at entry
_repairSchema strips chineseName/showLabel from entities before schema validation because ALLOWED_ENTITY_KEYS is missing those keys
CUA [spec-phase-skipped] token had no rootCause branch → resolved to 'unknown', bypassing fast-escalation guard and burning up to 7 recode rounds before FATAL

Screenshot-sharing CUA failures hit FP circuit-breaker FATAL (2–3 rounds) because 'screenshot sharing' is absent from VISUAL_FREEZE_PHRASES and has no FP-breaker exemption, so full-regen is never attempted before hard abort.
CC CLI exit-1 error message drops stdout content, producing a constant 'Exit code 1' string that trips the fix-loop circuit breaker after exactly 3 identical rounds

noPhasesCompleted AND-condition lets visual_freeze win over codegen_init_failure when VLM issue text contains a phase-coverage count, routing zero-progress tasks to a non-retryable FATAL instead of the retryable CODE/full-regen path.
Ambient system env var CUA_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS=2700000 (45 min) overrides the code's updated 75-min default, causing legitimate 47-min CUA runs to be killed prematurely.
Schema generation times out (SIGTERM → exit 143) because the 2-minute hardcoded timeout in codegen-schema.cjs is too short for the Claude Code CLI when tool-call overhead adds an extra API round-trip
parseSimplifyResponse passes raw ```json-fenced text to JSON.parse when LLM omits closing code fence (truncated response)
Ajv v6 error objects expose `dataPath`, not `instancePath`; validate-schema.cjs uses the v8 property, producing `undefined` in every validation error message
Post-loop phase coverage gate fires with no retries because LLM reviewer silently passed code using wrong/generic phaseId names
spec-validate throws a permanent dead-end error because it never invalidates the spec-extract checkpoint, so every worker retry skips spec-extract and re-validates the same hallucinated entity names
Pre-recode guard threshold was 60 min (RECODE_BUFFER_MS=15 min in .env) — tasks legitimately running to 64 min were killed 11 min before recode was truly needed

visual_freeze FATAL fires prematurely (at _noProgressRounds=2) because the cross-streak consecutiveSameIssue counter reaches SAME_ISSUE_REGEN_THRESHOLD within the first two no-progress rounds of a new streak, bypassing the mandatory full-regen attempt
LLM spec extractor writes abbreviated entity names (e.g. 'drill' vs 'BasicDrill'); two-tier exact/case-insensitive guard misses them, burning 6 full-pipeline retries per task.
LLM camelCases entity names in specs; entityLowerToCanonical canonical values are stored un-trimmed, allowing whitespace-polluted names to escape the auto-fix and reach codegen

commitSpecs() mutates ctx.blueprint.specs before the drift-fatal throw, causing the canRetry second attempt to build a non-null beforeFp from entity-valid attempt-1 output and then false-fatal against a legitimate second extraction

drift-fatal fires on spec-extract retry because spec-validate mutates entity names in-place on ctx.blueprint.specs, making specsAreReusable() return true so beforeFp is preserved, but the on-disk cache (pre-mutation names) is deemed stale and discarded — forcing a fresh LLM extraction whose non-deterministic phaseIds diverge from the now-entity-corrected baseline
visual_freeze FATAL fires at _noProgressRounds=3 (first post-regen CUA pass), terminating before regenerated code gets a second verification pass
skeleton.split truthy 判断导致 fs.writeFileSync 写 undefined
编译服务器连接被 reset,通常是 LINUX_BUILD_URL 指向僵尸远端而非 127.0.0.1
LLM spec extractor emits camelCase entity names; strict case-sensitive Set lookup in spec-validate blocks the pipeline with no retry path
CUA fix loop overshoots the 45-min wall-clock budget because the time guard only fires at round start, not before the expensive recode step
noPhasesCompleted cases are mis-classified as visual_freeze, delivering wrong codegen advice on round 1 and guaranteeing FATAL on round 2 — repeated 5× by task-level retries
visual_freeze short-circuit fires too late (≥3 rounds) because isProgressing discards 0→1 phase progress and the diagnosis keyword list was too narrow to catch VLM synonym phrasing
